summary: Implemented `py:type` as a `PyObject` specialization with optional canonical annotation parsing, alias registration, Python-domain lookup, and the specified index text. Added documentation, a release note, and regression coverage, including HTML checks for alias and annotation links. All 96 Python-domain tests passed with the prepared interpreter; `git diff --check` passed. The run reported one environment warning about urllib3 and LibreSSL. I didn’t run the full repository test suite.
